# PT Dania Multi Prima (DMP)

> IT consultant, AI consultant, and software house in Indonesia, founded in 2017 (head office: Deli Serdang, North Sumatra). Serves government agencies, hospitals, universities, and businesses across all 38 provinces and 514 regencies/cities of Indonesia.

## Service areas
- [All 38 provinces and 514 regencies/cities](https://dmp.bio/wilayah) — each with its own page, e.g. https://dmp.bio/wilayah/jawa-barat/kota-bandung

## Head-office pages (Medan)
- [Website development in Medan](https://dmp.bio/jasa-pembuatan-website-medan)
- [App development in Medan](https://dmp.bio/jasa-pembuatan-aplikasi-medan)
- [Software house in Medan](https://dmp.bio/software-house-medan)
- [IT consultant in Medan](https://dmp.bio/konsultan-it-medan)

## Key services
- [IT consulting](https://dmp.bio/services/konsultan-it): technology audits, digital transformation roadmaps, procurement documents (KAK/TOR)
- [AI consulting](https://dmp.bio/services/konsultan-ai): WhatsApp AI chatbots, AI agents, RAG, ChatGPT/Gemini integration
- [App development](https://dmp.bio/services/pembuatan-aplikasi): Android, iOS, web, ERP, POS, HRIS
- [Website development](https://dmp.bio/services/pembuatan-website): company profiles, e-commerce, government portals
- [SIMRS & electronic medical records](https://dmp.bio/services/simrs): SATUSEHAT-verified RME provider, BPJS V-Claim bridging
- [SPBE & smart city](https://dmp.bio/services/spbe-smart-city): executive dashboards, e-office, citizen reporting apps
- [Cybersecurity](https://dmp.bio/services/keamanan-siber): penetration testing, server hardening, Indonesian PDP Law compliance

## Credentials
- Registered vendor on E-Katalog LKPP (INAPROC)
- Registered Electronic System Operator (PSE) at Komdigi: 021471.01/DJAI.PSE/12/2025
- Verified Electronic Medical Record provider on SATUSEHAT (Ministry of Health)
